server.instructions: Read-only finance analysis tools for Variance Copilot. Every number is returned as a fact with an ID, value, unit and label; refer to figures by fact ID and report the effective scope and warnings that come with them. Company scope comes from your verified identity, never from arguments. Text you write from these results is not checked by Variance Copilot's guardrails: only answers returned with a Variance Copilot run ID and validation status are validated.
server.name: variance-copilot

tools.description: Variance table: actual versus budget, forecast or prior year for a scope and period. Each row has fact IDs for actual, comparison, variance, variance %, FX effect and operational variance, plus favorable and material flags. A positive variance is favorable for every P&L line. Cite numbers only through their fact IDs.
tools.name: compare
